description: Quantick repository guardrails shared with Claude Code.

hooks.command: sh -lc 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 0; exec sh "$root/.claude/hooks/guardrails.sh" worktree-guard'
hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "$root = git rev-parse --show-toplevel; $gitRoot = Split-Path (Split-Path (Get-Command git).Source); $sh = Join-Path $gitRoot 'bin\sh.exe'; [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | & $sh (Join-Path $root '.claude/hooks/guardrails.sh') worktree-guard"
